info.title: Call Center System API
info.description:
Backend of the **call-center system**: ticket routing, department ownership and
employee assignment.

The API follows the routing hierarchy of the business:

```
Customer -> Customer Care -> Department -> Department Manager -> One or more employees
```

Key rules enforced server side (never only in the UI):

* Customer Care **forwards** a ticket to a department; it can never assign employees.
* A forwarded ticket waits in the destination **manager's** queue.
* A manager assigns **one employee, several employees or the entire team** - always
  employees of the department that currently owns the ticket.
* There is exactly **one ticket** and **one overall status**, no per-employee copies.
* A **transfer** moves ownership (and clears the assignment); a **collaboration
  request** asks another department for help while ownership stays put.
* Every assignment, transfer, status and priority change is written to history and
  to the ticket timeline - history is never overwritten.
* Internal notes are never returned to customer accounts.

Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (from `POST /auth/login`) on every
endpoint except login and refresh.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Sign in, refresh, profile and permissions

AssignmentMember.description: One employee participating in the assignment (normalised, never a CSV field).

Assignment.description: A manager decision about who works on the ticket. Only one assignment is active at a time; previous ones stay as history.

Ticket.description: Full ticket state: the single responsible department, the current assignment with its participants, and the complete history.

DepartmentPeriod.description: A period during which one department was responsible for the ticket.

CollaborationRequest.description: Assistance from another department WITHOUT transferring ownership.

visibility.description: INTERNAL notes are never returned to customer accounts

ForwardTicketRequest.description: Customer Care routes the ticket to the responsible department.

AssignTicketRequest.description: Either a list of employees of the responsible department, or the entire team. Sending both is rejected.

TransferTicketRequest.description: Hands ownership to another department and clears the current assignment.

DepartmentQueueSummary.description: Counts behind the "My Department - Incoming Tickets" dashboard.

TicketLifecycleReport.description: Management view: time per department, participants, transfers, escalations and SLA.

post.summary: Customer Care forwards the ticket to a department
post.description: Requires ticket.forward. The ticket lands UNASSIGNED in the destination department manager's queue - Customer Care can never pick the employees itself. Any existing assignment is cleared and the move is recorded in the department history.

post.summary: Department manager assigns one employee, several employees, or the whole team
post.description: Requires ticket.assign (plus ticket.assign.multiple / ticket.assign.team) AND management of the department that currently owns the ticket. Employees must belong to that department. The previous assignment is closed, never deleted.
